'''Outpost Cresh''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] outpost on the edges of the [[Whiterock Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]]. A bunker built between the Whiterock Wastes and the [[Highmount Ridge]], it was used by the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] as a command post during the [[Battle of Hoth (Galactic War)|battle]] for Hoth.
